remarks: UPDATED, GORGEOUS HOME WITH WATER VIEWS! ENJOY BEAUTIFUL SUNRISES OVER THE WATER EVERY MORNING! EXPERIENCE COASTAL LIVING IN STAMFORD'S HIGHLY DESIRABLE COVE ISLAND PARK COMMUNITY! Ideally located just a few blocks from the beach, this stunning, sun-filled open-flow home offers 3 bedrooms, with a flexible family room/4th bedroom option with full bath, perfect for guests or in-law. Most recent updates include a new dishwasher, refrigerator, washer/dryer in 2023, new patio with blue stone, new walkway and front stoop with blue stone and concrete all in 2024, interior freshly painted and epoxy floor in garage in 2026. Live like you're on vacation all year long! Enjoy kayaking, multi-use trails, boating, or just relax at the beach at Cove Island Park, and there's also ice skating at the Terry Connors Ice Rink! Visit SoundWaters Coastal Education Center which also has summer programs! Commuters delight with convenience to downtown Stamford, Metro-North train station, major highways. Just minutes to Chelsea Piers, Stamford's downtown restaurants, shopping, and entertainment.
